article.title_en: Our Lady of Grace Parish Ministry: food pantry in Brooklyn
article.summary_es: Our Lady of Grace Parish Ministry es una despensa de alimentos y cocina comunitaria en Brooklyn, según el mapa Food Help NYC de la ciudad.
article.summary_en: Our Lady of Grace Parish Ministry is a food pantry and soup kitchen in Brooklyn, listed on the City's Food Help NYC map.
how_they_help_es: Despensa de alimentos los lunes y miércoles de 9 am a 1 pm.
Cocina comunitaria (sopa) los miércoles de 12 pm a 12:30 pm.
Está en 2322 E 4th St, Brooklyn, NY 11223.
La lista no indica qué alimentos entrega ni requisitos.
how_they_help_en: Food pantry on Mondays and Wednesdays, 9am-1pm.
Located at 2322 E 4th St, Brooklyn, NY 11223.
The listing does not say what food is given or any requirements.
visit_tips_es: La despensa funciona lunes y miércoles de 9 am a 1 pm.
La cocina comunitaria abre solo el miércoles de 12 pm a 12:30 pm.
Llame al (718) 645-2120 antes de ir para confirmar detalles.
visit_tips_en: The pantry is open Mondays and Wednesdays, 9am-1pm.
The soup kitchen is open only Wednesdays, 12pm-12:30pm.
Call (718) 645-2120 before visiting to confirm details.
